name: 4134-sharegpteagle-llama2-7b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf as the target, lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B as the speculative draft, both served in float16. The target is GATED on HuggingFace -- request access before running; the draft repo is ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90), one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 1200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-first-turn-1500.jsonl` -- the first human turn of 1500 real ShareGPT conversations, no chat template applied; prompt lengths 2 to 2894 tokens (median 154, mean 327), output capped at 512 tokens with `ignore_eos` FALSE and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model for faster replies, handling 32 concurrent real-world conversation openers on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the parser.

model-path: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 16
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
random-seed: 42
